subject: Apply a high-frequency detail sharpening pass: enhance edge micro-contrast using a fine-radius unsharp mask, sharpen fine texture detail in surfaces, fabric, hair, and skin pores without introducing haloing or oversharpening artifacts. Preserve smooth tonal gradients in skies and out-of-focus areas — do not sharpen soft bokeh regions. The result should look like a crisper, more resolute capture of the same image, as if shot with a sharper lens or at a higher resolution.
